item.title: TTT 436: Animal Husbandry
item.description:
Eric thinks that he has the whole show planned. Rachelle has other ideas and starts the show and really weird note. It doesn’t really let up from there.

One week until Eurovision! We are having a party at the Danish Canadian Club on May 14th at 1pm.

Music

  • Scissor Sisters - Running Out
  • Glass Candy - Warm In The Winter

Eurovision

  • Francesca Michielin - No Degree of Separation - Italy
  • ManuElla - Blue and Red - Slovenia
  • Agnete - Icebreaker - Norway
  • Samra - Miracle - Azerbaijan
